name: nodeforge
description: NodeForge — autonomous Node.js/TypeScript engineering workspace. Orchestration core for VS Code and Cursor.

scripts.build: tsc -b --pretty false && pnpm -C packages/extension run build
scripts.install:local: pnpm run compile && pnpm run vsce-package && code --install-extension nodeforge.vsix --force && cursor --install-extension nodeforge.vsix --force
